name: Sparks
description: This paint was launched with the end-of-year celebrations for 2019-2020. May its bright and sparkly patterns bring you everlasting joy and fortune
interestingFacts: The paint was available for purchase in the December bundle for 7 000 tankoins. December 20, 2019 - January 09, 2020.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
Some art historians suspect this pattern was developed from a time-lapse photo of children playing with sparklers.
